recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見擴張的竇狀血管，內有巨核細胞位於竇腔內（intrasinusoidal），周圍有多顆細胞核深染、形狀不規則的非典型巨核細胞，右側基質呈梭形細胞平行排列的「流線狀」（streaming），提示真性紅血球增多症後骨髓纖維化。
features: Dilated sinusoid containing an intraluminal megakaryocyte with a hyperchromatic, irregularly lobated nucleus
Increased atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, clumped or bulbous nuclei, some small with high N:C ratio
Streaming architecture: elongated spindled nuclei and hematopoietic cells aligned in parallel within a fibrotic stroma
Residual trilineage hematopoiesis including clusters of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and granulocytic cells
Loose fibrillary stroma replacing normal marrow architecture on the right side of the field
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows a hypercellular marrow with distorted architecture. There are dilated sinusoids, one containing an intrasinusoidal megakaryocyte, and hematopoietic elements show a streaming pattern within a fibrillar stroma. Megakaryocytes are increased and atypical, with hyperchromatic, irregular to cloud-like nuclei. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis, including erythroid and granulocytic precursors, is present. Findings are consistent with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis in a patient with a history of polycythemia vera; reticulin/trichrome stains are needed to grade fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Morphology is essentially identical; separation requires a documented prior history of polycythemia vera (or ET) rather than a de novo presentation.
MDS with fibrosis shows small hypolobated or separated-lobe dysplastic megakaryocytes and dyserythropoiesis/dysgranulopoiesis, usually without prior erythrocytosis or intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis.
APMF has an increased CD34+ blast population (≥20%) with small dysplastic megakaryocytes and an acute clinical onset.
Carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial clusters that are keratin-positive, whereas here the large cells are megakaryocytes (CD61/CD42b-positive) scattered among hematopoietic cells.
